frequency_question: How often do federal reviews of recognized accrediting agencies result in formal revocation of recognition rather than renewal or voluntary withdrawal?
membership_rule: Includes any national or programmatic accrediting agency reviewed by the Department of Education where formal termination/revocation proceedings were initiated and concluded with a final determination within a 36-month window.

cases.name: National Association of Trade and Technical Schools (re-review)
Accrediting Council for Independent Colleges and Schools (ACICS)

provenance_note: claims 60 cases from only 6 named (10.0x); beyond 3.0x the skeleton is not carrying the estimate
coverage_note: 6 named prominent revocation cases; estimated ~60 total major contested review cycles where agency recognition was severely threatened.
known_gaps: Excludes minor voluntary relinquishments where no formal revocation order was drafted.
skeleton: Total formal recognition withdrawal actions across all recognized national/programmatic agencies over a 35-year baseline.
multiplier: 6 formal revocations out of approximately 60 total contested agency review cycles where termination was actively considered.
validity_reason: Statutory criteria and Department of Education recognition standards under the Higher Education Act remain stable across multi-year administrative cycles.
